note: How each published model forecast turned out, from data/model-ledger.json, data/model-runs.json, data/climatology.json and data/model-measured.json by forecast-models.js gradeModelRecord (run by tools/run-models.js daily, reproducible with tools/rebuild-model-grades.js). Correct if its weather line was crossed on at least one day of its window, a false alarm if not, pending until every day of the window has a settled NASA POWER measurement (one at least 14 days old when fetched). Verdicts and misses are both recomputed on every run from settled days only. A miss is a day the line was crossed at a place a published run was watching, with no forecast for it. "events" merges forecasts at one place for one hazard whose windows overlap or touch; "days" scores every watched place-day, as the backtest does.
